name: Login Shinai Aida ni Netorareru Heroine-tachi...
original_name: ログインしない間に寝取られるヒロイン達…
source:
"Independent Nation: St. Arect Women's Academy's War Chronicle"
is a student raising MMO simulation game in full-diving style.

Players become a teacher in the academy, whose obligation is to protect 
female students from vicious-minded guys who try to invade the academy.

Students are all programmed with artificial intelligence, which means 
they chat, think and take behaviors just like humans in this game.

The only difference from the real humans is that they
are programmed to fall in love with me.

In this virtual space, I had the first experience of being loved.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE215116.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《沒登入時被別人睡走的女主角們……》
《獨立國家：聖阿雷克特女子學院戰記》是一款採用全潛行風格的學生養成MMO模擬遊戲。

玩家將成為學院教師，職責是保護女學生，不讓企圖侵入學院的惡意男子得逞。

遊戲中的學生全部由人工智慧程式控制，因此她們會像人類一樣聊天、思考並採取行動。

她們與真人唯一的區別在於：她們被設定為會愛上我。

在這個虛擬空間裡，我第一次體驗到了被愛。

（來源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE215116.html]DLsite英文頁面[/url]）
